judged_text: The success-path tests assert collaborator calls but never assert the response: neither asserts which template renders ('best' vs 'loading') and TopicRetriever.expects(:new) carries no argument constraint, so the embed_url forwarded through the job is unverified. adjudication.rationale: In `spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb` under the "success" context, the tests mostly assert collaborator interactions (`TopicRetriever.expects(:new)`, `TopicView.expects(:new)`) and generic success headers, but they never assert which template/view is rendered (`best` vs `loading`). In particular, the "no previous embed" test doesn’t assert that `loading` was rendered, and the "topic_id is found" test doesn’t assert that `best` was rendered, so a regression that always renders `loading` could slip through as long as those collaborator expectations still occur. Also, `TopicRetriever.expects(:new).returns(retriever)` has no argument constraint, so it would not catch forwarding the wrong `embed_url` into the retriever/job path (the job ultimately calls `TopicRetriever.new(args[:embed_url], ...)`). This is a test coverage/precision issue, not a defect in the implementation shown.
